status: SEED for Codex WP-5. Maturity is a starting proposal from a read-only sweep at dev 55032e88. STANDARD = one shared implementation exists and a trusted probe drives it; CANDIDATE = a written spec or one implementation exists but is not yet the shared way; GAP = the game needs one way and none is written. Re-verify every path at your head.

patterns.name: One guided target
patterns.child_promise: At most one place glows as 'go here'; the voice names it; a pointer or edge beacon shows it even when it is off screen.
anti_patterns: two gold doors at once (door handoff D8)
resting doors louder than the plot door (D5)
no off-screen pointer (D4)

patterns.name: Highlight follows the painted object, not the touch box
patterns.child_promise: A glow outlines the thing itself; the finger target may be bigger but is never drawn.
anti_patterns: door cue up to 14 units off the frame and 36-40 units too high (D3)
Moonflower cue 3.0x its doorway (D3)

patterns.name: One pointer vocabulary
patterns.child_promise: The same pointer always means 'touch here'.
reference: ghost_hand art referenced by 14 scripts at dev 55032e88 (grep)
anti_patterns: sweep: at least nine pointer styles in one Day One arc
Day One rebuild handoff proposes the ghost hand as the only pointer while the door handoff proposes the guide star as the castle's only moving pointer

patterns.name: Colour meanings
patterns.child_promise: A colour means the same thing everywhere (for example gold = the story wants you here).
anti_patterns: sweep: red means plot for props, gold means plot for doors, red pulses on the back arrow, gold marks boss counters

patterns.name: Help ladder
patterns.child_promise: If the child waits, help grows in the same steps everywhere: re-say, show, widen, then assist - never a free win.
anti_patterns: sweep: five different idle ladders across current handoffs and code (see seed/tokens_seed.json TOK-ASSIST-DELAYS-S)

patterns.name: Roshan does the job
patterns.child_promise: Roshan travels to the job, touches it with her hand or tool, the world changes, then progress is saved.
anti_patterns: MA-PLAY-004 open cases: bathtub, craft room, baby-eagle rescue, waterfall
arrival radii redeclared per script (sweep)

patterns.name: Truthful object change
patterns.child_promise: Touching a thing changes that thing (door opens, water pours), not a generic bounce.
anti_patterns: whole-card bounce or spin used as the action (superseded idea in design 06 section 15)

patterns.name: A card owns its pixels once
patterns.child_promise: There is never a ghost copy of an object painted behind the real one.
anti_patterns: MA-VIS-007: two bathtubs, baked Castle plates, Detective crown

patterns.name: Draw-order roles
patterns.child_promise: Roshan and the thing to touch are never hidden by cues, panels or scenery.
anti_patterns: door cue above Roshan (door handoff D6)
rescue star under the nook, instruction panel over bunnies, follower over Roshan (visual polish handoff T15, T16, O1)
route cards over Roshan's tail (MA-OPERA-012)

patterns.name: The exact line for every objective
patterns.child_promise: What Roshan or a friend says matches what is on screen; there is no generic 'yay' for an instruction.
reference: scripts/audio_director.gd required-event lists and prefix opt-outs
anti_patterns: scripts/audio_director.gd:318 still describes the recorded 'yay' as the graceful fallback
MA-ACCESS-001, MA-ACCESS-002, MA-ACCESS-003
door handoff D11: voice and screen disagree

patterns.name: One way back, spoken and pointed
patterns.child_promise: Leaving is always the same gesture in the same place, and it returns the child to where they came from.
reference: StorybookUI style_back_button (sweep: used by the start menu only)
anti_patterns: sweep: at least six Back/exit incidents between 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-23
Android Back still quits (quit_on_go_back unset, Day One handoff OD-5)
door handoff D12: return re-spawns at the wrong door

patterns.name: One celebration ceremony
patterns.child_promise: Every earned success celebrates the same recognisable way, and praise is never cut off or given for a refusal.
reference: sweep: main.gd _celebrate_pose, MedalSystem._celebrate, OperaCareerWorld2D.celebrate, _sparkle_burst are separate implementations
anti_patterns: success voiced as 'Try again!' (Day One player-experience handoff DO-17, sweep)
success sound on a refusal (door handoff D11)
MA-PERF-002 per-call sparkle allocation

patterns.name: Friendly boss with a guaranteed finish
patterns.child_promise: A boss is a friend in trouble; warnings are painted and readable; intentional play always finishes within a set time; mashing never beats intent.
anti_patterns: Grand Puff: a 3.5 s-reaction dodger never finishes; mashing is as fast as intent (Day One rebuild handoff D1R-02/03/17)
boss cue style revised four times between 2026-09-05 and 2026-09-13 (sweep)

patterns.name: Story clip between scenes
patterns.child_promise: A short movie plays only between scenes and never replaces something the child does.
anti_patterns: only the first room's completion clip played (fixed 2026-09-23)

patterns.name: Persistent construction
patterns.child_promise: Each job visibly adds to the same object, which is still there after a restart.
anti_patterns: superseded ten-strawberry cake (design/10_CHAPTER_REFERENCE_LIBRARY.md section 4)

patterns.name: Landmark journey with exact return
patterns.child_promise: A visible landmark invites a short trip, and coming back puts the child exactly where they left.
reference: scripts/probe_fairy_conservatory_route.gd (not in a trusted roster at dev 55032e88)
anti_patterns: superseded direct castle-to-fairy door (collapsed geography)

patterns.name: Picture-first interface
patterns.child_promise: Big picture buttons, one style, one neutral way back; text only helps the adult.
anti_patterns: MA-TYPE-002 bypass clusters; 43 local size overrides in 13 files (sweep)
new Day One activities building Labels without StorybookUI (sweep)

patterns.name: Companion follower
patterns.child_promise: Rescued friends follow Roshan on their own side and never cover her.
anti_patterns: rainbow follower drawn over Roshan (visual polish AESTHETICS_PLAN, sweep)

patterns.child_promise: Each character moves like themselves: attention, action, contact, settle.

Lagoon card faced backwards (fixed 2026-09-23)
